subject: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
title: Hegseth tomb guard medal: Soldier who scolded his group is honored
answer: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026, awarded the Joint Service Commendation Medal to Spc. Thomas Iglesias, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier sentinel who a day earlier had ordered Hegseth's group to keep silent after someone laughed during photos at the tomb on Veterans Day.
in_the_news: Video of the Veterans Day reprimand at Arlington National Cemetery spread widely online, and Hegseth's decision to honor the guard the next day turned an awkward moment into a show of support for the tomb's strict rules.
body:
After the Veterans Day observance at Arlington on Nov. 11, Hegseth, his wife, his chief of staff and other aides posed for photos on the steps in front of the tomb. When a loud laugh was heard, Iglesias called out the sentinels' standard warning: "All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times."

The next day Hegseth pinned the medal on Iglesias at the Pentagon while welcoming members of the Old Guard, posting photos on X with the words "We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist." A Pentagon official said the award recognized his "execution of his duties" at the tomb. Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell told CBS News the soldier "correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to maintain decorum." The Joint Service Commendation Medal is rarely given to junior enlisted troops.

The tomb holds unidentified service members from World War I, World War II and the Korean War. Soldiers of the Army's 3rd U.S. Infantry Regiment, known as the Old Guard, have guarded it around the clock in all weather since 1948. Reprimanding noisy or disrespectful visitors is part of the job: a guard told the Army in 2022 that sentinels address crowds two or three times a day.

faq.q: Who is the tomb guard who reprimanded Hegseth's group?
faq.a: Spc. Thomas Iglesias of the 3rd U.S. Infantry Regiment, the Old Guard, which guards the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

faq.q: What medal did Hegseth give the guard?
faq.a: The Joint Service Commendation Medal, presented at the Pentagon on Nov. 12, 2026.
"All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times" — the standard warning sentinels give visitors at the tomb.

faq.q: Are tomb guards allowed to scold visitors?
faq.a: Yes. Sentinels are expected to enforce silence and respect at the tomb and do so regardless of who the visitors are.
